about.description: SPX500 is a cash settled perpetual market on ADEN referencing S&P 500 Index. The market is quoted and settled in USDC and marked against ADEN's index price rather than a single spot venue. It conveys no ownership of the underlying and no claim on any issuer. ADEN publishes the market under the identifier SPX500-PERPUSDC, so the quote asset forms part of the venue's own market name. Delisted 2026-09-08: ADEN is a Gate Layer front-end onto Gate’s futures book (brokerapi.gateperps.com returns identical position_size/trade_size to api.gateio.ws), so this duplicates the gate: coverage.
